headline: Built for people who actually ship
subheadline: Quotes from teams currently running production traffic on the platform.

items.quote: Switched from Next on Vercel — preview deploys are actually atomic now. The rollback in 6 seconds claim is real; I've used it twice.
items.author: Maya Patel

items.quote: We replaced our entire CDN + observability stack and saved $400/mo. Support reply times are absurdly fast for the price.
items.author: Diego Romero

items.quote: First deploy platform where the per-project pricing actually makes sense for a small team. No surprise per-seat costs as we hired.
items.author: Anya Kowalski

items.quote: Branch preview URLs that just work, with environment variables that just work. I forgot how much friction we used to have.
items.author: Soren Mikkelsen

items.quote: Documentation is dense and assumes you know what you're doing — exactly what I want as a senior dev. No fluff.
items.author: Priya Iyer

items.quote: The atomic deploy + instant rollback combo means I deploy on Fridays now. The platform earns trust by being correct, not by marketing.
items.author: Marcus Lee
